fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Zielinski and I live at 953 Willow Court, Dover, DE 19955. You can reach me on (555) 908-4479 or dmitri.zielinski@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 10 August 2025 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2024-00081. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Zielinski on (555) 908-4479 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 10 August 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Tomas Delgado gave a statement by phone.
Dmitri sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
